title: Saer
description: Create a design system, then give coding agents evidence of where the implementation diverges from it.
techStack: Python, TypeScript, OKLCH, CSS analysis, MCP
status: Private beta; updated Create component workspace prepared locally

blocks.heading: Creation and implementation belong together
blocks.body: Gamut explored building colour palettes. Saer takes the broader problem: create a usable design system, then inspect the code that is supposed to follow it. Saer Create covers colour, typography, shape and density. The local scanner reconstructs declared foundations and compares them with actual usage.

blocks.heading: A system you can inspect before exporting
blocks.body: The public Create interface exposes OKLCH scales, contrast ratios, heading and body fonts, a type scale, radius, elevation and density. A light and dark interface preview puts those choices together. Exports include CSS, Tailwind, shadcn/ui and design tokens; saer-system.json carries the system into the CLI workflow.

blocks.heading: The component code needs to be reachable
blocks.body: Create already generated seven React components, but the browser hid their source inside the system bundle. The current local redesign separates Foundations, Components, and Export and handoff. Its component workspace renders the exact downloadable source, exposes button variants and control states, and lets a developer copy a component or download it with the required theme. The font catalogue expands from 44 curated families to a dated 1,840-family Google Fonts snapshot; only chosen font files are requested. This release is prepared locally and is not yet the public Create interface.

blocks.heading: A component needs a usable handoff
blocks.body: The local component kit now packages all seven previewed component sources, the required theme, optional selected-font loading, an example and setup instructions in one ZIP. The same archive carries saer-system.json, so the foundations can be reopened rather than reconstructed by hand. I verified the browser download, inspected its twelve files and restored the exported configuration through Create. On smaller screens the foundation controls collapse so the selected workspace is reachable.

blocks.heading: Use the portfolio as a real customer
blocks.body: The portfolio uses an adapted Prism Select. Saer’s first component audit resolved its actual use but did not know its library origin. The local follow-up preserves that origin in a source-copy record, checks the local file checksum and reports the resolved use. Radix imports and configured shadcn copies have separate evidence paths. An attributed copy is not the same as independently authenticated upstream code, and a dependency declaration is not proof of use. This scanner extension is local and unreleased.

items.alt: Saer Create with green, lavender and charcoal foundations, a component library selector, a live button variant preview and source export.
items.caption: Local release candidate, 20 November 2026. The browser previews are built from the same component sources offered for download.

blocks.heading: Keep exact and inferred findings apart
blocks.context: A literal equal to a declared token is a different kind of evidence from a value merely close to one.

options.label: Present every suggestion as a correction
options.detail: A simpler list, but it hides how much interpretation the finding required.

options.label: Preserve the evidence state
options.detail: Separate exact matches from experimental near-matches and show unresolved or conflicting evidence explicitly.

blocks.outcome: A near-match is a review decision. Static accessibility checks are source findings, not a claim that the rendered interface conforms to WCAG.

blocks.heading: Give the system to the agent
blocks.body: The full product’s local MCP interface supplies tokens, components and guidance before a coding task, and checks the changes afterwards. Scanning is deterministic and local. Code, report files and paths stay on the device; optional cloud summaries are a separate flow. The connected portfolio review surface is narrower and currently exposes colour evidence only, so it is not used to substantiate the other analysis areas.

blocks.heading: Read first, change deliberately
blocks.gave: An audit does not silently rewrite the code to make every finding disappear.
blocks.got: The scan is read-only apart from its report. Reviewed fixes, agent setup and creating a system are separate actions with their own write boundaries.

blocks.heading: Evidence and limits
blocks.body: The public beta and Create interface were inspected on 20 November 2026. The local follow-up includes a fresh component-domain audit of this portfolio, export round-trip checks and a static Create build. It does not claim an independent full re-run of the published Lunary results or certification of every browser and assistive-technology combination. The beta currently targets macOS on Apple Silicon.
